events.title: Playtest Update: Clearer Interaction Feedback
events.summary: The Steam Playtest has been updated with clearer interaction feedback across the game. Buttons, tabs, cards, selectors, and keyboard focus states are now easier to read. The main menu also has a new terminal-style response: targeting brackets on hover, a short scan, and an confirmation on click. No save reset is required. If anything still feels unclear or unresponsive, use Send Feedback or Join Discord from the title screen.
